basic_details.job_title: TAFCOFED Social Mobilization Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Tamil Nadu State Apex Fisheries Cooperative Federation Ltd. (TAFCOFED), Chennai, is engaging Social Mobilization Domain Experts on a purely contractual basis under the PMMSY scheme, for strengthening Primary Fishermen Co-Operative Societies into Fish Farmer Producer Organizations (FFPOs). The tentative number of posts is 5, with consolidated pay of Rs.30,000 and Rs.5,000 travel allowance reimbursed on bills. Applications are accepted by e-mail to [email protected] or as a hard copy, from 25 November 2026 until 5 PM on 15 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Fill in the prescribed application form (the proforma on page 6 of the notice).
Enclose attested copies of qualification certificates, as the form states; experience certificates are to be produced.
Send the application by e-mail to [email protected], or deliver or post a hard copy, on or before 15.12.2026 by 5 PM.
Superscript the hard copy with "Application for the post of ……………………………….."

Address the hard copy to: Office of the Joint Director of Fisheries/Administrator, TAFCOFED, Integrated Office Complex For Animal Husbandry, Fisheries And Fishermen Welfare Department, (4th Floor), No.571, Anna Salai, Nandanam, Chennai – 35.

The form asks for the domain applied for, name, date of birth and age as on 01.07.2026, gender, marital status, category (SC / ST / OBC / OC), father's or husband's name, correspondence and permanent addresses, mobile number, e-mail address, qualifications, working experience, current employment details, and names, addresses, phone numbers and e-mail IDs of two references, with a signed declaration.
important_instructions: Applications received after the prescribed deadline will not be entertained under any circumstances. The Joint Director of Fisheries / Administrator reserves the right to accept or reject any application and will not correspond with applicants not short-listed for the interview. The Joint Director of Fisheries / Administrator reserves the right to cancel, modify or postpone the notification without prior notice. Selected candidates may be posted anywhere within Tamil Nadu and must be willing to travel extensively within the allotted cluster/districts. Selected candidates submit educational and experience certificates, proof of identity, proof of address, recent passport-size photographs and a medical fitness certificate (if required). Selected candidates must sign an acceptance of the Terms and Conditions before joining duty. Working hours are those prescribed by TAFCOFED, and work beyond office hours may be required. Unauthorized absence may result in deduction of remuneration or termination. Confidentiality, a code of conduct and disclosure of any conflict of interest apply; misconduct may result in termination.

content_sections.heading: About TAFCOFED
content_sections.text: TAFCOFED is based in Chennai. Under the PMMSY scheme, NCDC is promoting Fish Farmers Producer Organizations by converting existing Primary Fisheries Co-operative Societies into FFPOs, and the notice says NCDC has empaneled TAFCOFED as a Cluster Based Business Organization. A total of 105 Primary Fisheries Co-Operative Societies have been selected for strengthening as FFPOs in Tamil Nadu.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice gives a tentative total of 5 Social Mobilization posts, one for each cluster below. Applicants residing in and around Chennai, Nagapattinam, Trichy, Madurai, Erode, Salem and Thoothukudi will be given preference for selection, subject to the required educational qualifications and previous experience.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives two alternative routes, each with its own experience requirement. Experience must be relevant, in mobilization of farmers, field demonstrations, organizing village level meetings etc. Age: minimum 25 years to 35 years as on 01.07.2026. The notice lists no age relaxation. Candidates must produce original certificates for verification at the time of joining. The notice does not list desirable qualifications. See the official notification for further detail on eligibility.

rows.essential_qualification: Social work (MSW) / Master of Social Science / Masters in Rural Studies / MBA rural management / Post Graduate Diploma in rural development (PGDRD), from a recognized university / institute
Social work (BSW) / Bachelor of Social Science / Bachelor of Rural Studies / BA in rural development, from a recognized university / institute

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary is Rs.30,000/- (Thirty thousand only). An additional amount of Rs.5,000 will be reimbursed as travel allowance based on submission of bills/receipts. The terms say Domain Experts are paid a consolidated monthly remuneration as fixed by TAFCOFED. No additional allowances, pension, bonus, gratuity or other service benefits are admissible unless specifically approved. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis under the FFPO programme and confers no right to claim regular employment in TAFCOFED or the Government of Tamil Nadu. The duration is up to 30.06.2027. The terms say the contract may be extended based on satisfactory performance and continuation of the project. TAFCOFED may end the contract at any time without assigning a reason by giving one month's notice or salary in lieu. The Domain Expert may resign by giving one month's written notice.

content_sections.heading: TAFCOFED Social Mobilization Job Description
content_sections.text: The Domain Expert shall: Provide technical guidance to FFPOs. Assist in business planning, value chain development, capacity building, and market linkage. Coordinate with government departments, financial institutions, and other stakeholders. Submit periodic reports and maintain project documentation. Complete all the work milestones for FFPOs as prescribed by NCDC, and perform any other duties assigned by TAFCOFED in connection with the project.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is based on scrutiny of applications followed by an interview and/or any other assessment method decided by TAFCOFED. The decision of the Selection Committee is final. Preference may be given to candidates from the cluster area of operation. The interview will be held in person at the Office of the Joint Director of Fisheries/Administrator, TAFCOFED, Integrated Office Complex For Animal Husbandry, Fisheries And Fishermen Welfare Department, (4th Floor), No.571, Anna Salai, Nandanam, Chennai – 35. Interview communication will be sent only to short-listed candidates through e-mail. The interview date is not given in the notice. Candidates must bring all the required certificates (original and copies) as mentioned in their application. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
